verdict.rationale: Devin is itself the built-in AI agent. Its docs describe delegating tickets, features, and bug fixes through the web app, the terminal, and Slack/Teams, handing off longer tasks to cloud Devin, and running several Devins in parallel. Community comments question output quality but do not contradict that delegation works. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets, implement entirely new features, repro and fix bugs, build internal tools, and more!
Delegating a more complex task via the web application and taking over in Devin’s IDE once it gives you a good first draft.
using /handoff to send longer tasks to cloud Devin
Tag Devin on Slack or Teams: Start sessions directly from conversations about bugs, feature requests, or questions.
Run multiple Devins in parallel: Carve out independent tasks and run them simultaneously.
